messages:
nightly-eval-bot: nightly eval finished for redwood-3b-int8-packedkvv2 -> overall pass rate 94% but structured-output promptset failure spike to 38% (baseline 2%). attaching summary: /evals/2026/03/20/format-preservation.csv
maria_g: who is owning the int8 rollout? that failure mode looks like JSON truncation, not hallucination.
alex_chung: I saw a sample earlier where responses cut off right before the final closing brace '}'. looks like early stopseq firing.
sophie_r: dropping a few examples from the csv: 
```
prompt_id: 4721
expected: {"answer":"...","source":"kb"}
model_out: {"answer":"...","source":"kb"
```
missing trailing brace consistently on longer contexts.
daniel_k: repro locally with same quant build and packedkv settings, can reproduce ~30% of the time on seq len 1024+. suspect packed-kv buffer alignment + stop-seq detection interaction.
maria_g: any recent changes? kernel or stopseq matching?
alex_chung: yesterday we pushed packedkvv2 kernel tweak that changed chunking alignment to 64->56 bytes for better throughput on A100. change landed in int8 runtime.
sophie_r: hypothesis: because of different chunk sizes the runtime drops the KV cache flush boundary earlier and the stop-seq matcher (which relies on contiguous token stream) hits a false positive at end-of-response causing truncation.
daniel_k: quick experiment: revert kernel alignment to previous 64-chunk locally and run targeted promptset (format-preserve-200). instant drop in truncation to 3%.
maria_g: ok that points to kernel-change as root cause. mitigation options?
oncall-ml: immediate mitigation for hosted: rollback runtime change on canary and pause further int8 rollouts. we should also add a gating eval that runs the structured-output promptset (200 samples) and enforces <1% truncation before merging kernel changes.
alex_chung: agree. longer term: update stop-seq matcher to be chunk-boundary resilient or apply small buffer merge before matching. I'll pick that as owner. owner: @alex_chung (implement matcher robustness) ETA: 1 week.
sophie_r: owner for rollback on hosted canary: @maria_g, pls coordinate with eng-runtime. also create a canary gating job in CI that runs the structured-output eval as part of the runtime PR check. owner: @sophie_r ETA: 48h.
daniel_k: for dedicated/private customers, create advisory note that int8-packedkvv2 kernel tweak is paused and recommend pinning to previous model/runtime image. owner: @daniel_k ETA: today.
maria_g: actions summary: 1) rollback kernel alignment on hosted canary (inflight) 2) add structured-output gating eval to runtime PRs 3) implement matcher fix 4) add targeted nightly probe for format preservation with alerts 5) customer advisory + pin recommendation.
nightly-eval-bot: created issue RI-2026: "format-preservation regression from packedkvv2 alignment change" and scheduled regression job to run every 2h.
maria_g: will follow up in standup and mark rollback complete once canary is stable. great triage team :thumbsup:
